_readme: Single source for github.com/qualixar and github.com/varun369 profile READMEs. Edit this file; scripts/build_readmes.py renders both. Stars, releases, download counts and dates are fetched live at build time. 'tier' is flagship or core; products created within new_window_days that are not flagship show under 'New'. A row with 'includes' counts those products too.

hero.line: Local-first memory for AI agents. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other MCP clients keep project context across sessions, and every recall points back to its source.

products.name: SuperLocalMemory
products.line: Governed, local-first memory for agents, with source-linked recall and workspace isolation.

products.name: brief2mp4 + brief2motion
products.line: Write a brief in Claude Code or Codex. brief2mp4 makes a checked MP4 in 82 art forms, even a [full documentary](https://youtu.be/aP2wHwG_dSA); brief2motion makes a website that moves ([film + website](https://youtu.be/fI3a3oDvLE4)). One install gives you both.

products.name: Bounded Loops
products.line: Agent loops and graphs that stop on an independent gate, with spend bounds set before the run and a hash-chained ledger.

products.name: Qualixar OS
products.line: Runs agent teams across multi-agent topologies, routes models by cost and quality, and judges outputs before they ship.

products.name: SkillFortify
products.line: Scans agent skills and MCP configs before they run: capability analysis, dependency checks, a bill of materials.

products.name: AgentAssert
products.line: Behavioral contracts for agents: preconditions, invariants and recovery checked at runtime, at the step that broke them.

products.name: AgentAssay
products.line: Regression testing for non-deterministic agents: statistical verdicts over repeated runs, on a fraction of the tokens.

products.name: Claude Bot Bridge
products.line: Claude Code hands tasks to Meta's Muse: a quick chat on your Mac, or a job on a task board you host.

products.name: touchless-mac
products.line: Control your Mac with your hand through the built-in camera. Fully local, written in Rust, with a video course.

products.name: ModStage
products.line: Run Codex, Grok, Gemini, Muse and other coding agents side by side inside Claude Code; watch, steer and approve each step.

products.name: Craft Studio Setup
products.line: One command installs free Office and Adobe alternatives on a Mac and connects them to Claude over MCP.

products.name: SuperLocalMemory plugin
products.line: SuperLocalMemory as a Claude Code plugin: memory, skills and hooks in one install.

products.name: Jev Decision Layer
products.line: Typed task, tool, skill and review routing for agents, with a receipt for every decision. Advisory, never an authorization.

products.name: SLM MCP Hub
products.line: One hub in front of every MCP server and client: three meta-tools, federated discovery, a shared cache.

products.name: SLM Mesh
products.line: Messages, shared state and file locks between agent sessions, on one machine or across a LAN.

products.name: Agent Amplifier
products.line: Hooks for coding agents: effort routing, goal anchoring, convergence checks and token budgets.
